text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a small but reproducible mismatch between provisional and confirmed tokens after a midflight model swap + retry. Looks like duplicate ledger writes when retry happens during prefetch/heartbeat churn. Anyone else run into this?
josh: Can you paste the request_id and a short log snippet?
maria: sure, here's the minimal log around the event (redacted):
```
2026-03-20T14:12:01.123Z request_id=rxk-9a session_id=sess-42 event=ledger_write type=provisional tokens=24
2026-03-20T14:12:01.145Z request_id=rxk-9a session_id=sess-42 event=ledger_write type=provisional tokens=24
2026-03-20T14:12:01.210Z request_id=rxk-9a session_id=sess-42 event=ledger_confirm tokens=48
```
looks like two provisional writes then a single confirm with the sum. billing shows only one confirmed charge but some customers saw double provisional spikes in metrics.
priya: this smells like the prefetch+heartbeat path. If prefetch populates a KV and then gets evicted mid-request, router retry can generate a second provisional ledger entry for the same logical session. We should dedupe on (session_id, request_seq) or attach a router-level fingerprint. cc josh
josh: dedupe on (session_id,seq) is ideal but not every client reliably sets seq/nonce. We could generate an ephemeral fingerprint at ingress and thread it through routing so ledger writes include fingerprint. That would let ledger dedupe without client changes. Any perf/regress concerns?
sam: also watch toolcall TTL / truncation path — if the toolcall triggers a short-circuit confirmation while a retry is still inflight, you can get two provisional entries where one gets confirmed from the truncated path and the other later confirmed by the retry. I can repro with a script that forces a toolcall timeout + immediate retry.
maria: can you drop the repro here? mine is flaky but I can run it nightly. For immediate mitigation, i lowered router.retry_window to 50ms and bumped heartbeat_grace to 200ms for the canary pool — reduced noise.
billing-bot: ALERT: provisional_confirm_mismatch spike +120% at 2026-03-20T14:12Z (route=/v1/generate model=redwood-xl customer=acme) :rotating_light:
priya: UX ask — console currently only shows billed (confirmed) tokens per route. We need a provisional vs confirmed breakdown (time series and per-route waterfall) + quick link to traces for the offending session. Ops can't triage these spikes without that.
josh: agree. I'll prototype a per-route waterfall row for "provisional tokens" and add a link/query to the tracecorrelator. Filing INF ticket INF-1221 to track console work + router/ledger dedupe plan.
maria: thanks — assigning to josh and priya to coordinate. If we can't ship a ledger dedupe quick win in the next 48h, add temporary mitigations: lower prefetch window and increase kv retention for high-volume customers.
